Crawling here is healthy (a page published 09-05 indexed within a day), so if they are not indexed 3 weeks in, the play has failed structurally and there is no point waiting for the deadline. (2) VERDICT ~2026-10-20, a week after the deadline: impressions on rental-safety terms at position <30, ideally a click or a lead. Interest does not return until the next cycle, so this is the whole result. (3) IF IT FAILS: cull. Already the weakest site in the network (15 impr/90d, avg pos 75.1, 0 clicks) and its other queries are all map-pack head terms a young site with no GBP, phone or address cannot win. Culling frees a Workers budget line and a nightly cron slot for the restumping sites, which are demonstrably stronger.
